Description By ASIL decomposition it is possible to decompose a safety requirement into two new safety requirements with potentially lower ASILs. This can be done, if the independence (freedom of interference) for the resulting requirements can be demonstrated. The modeling of the corresponding INDEPENDENCE relation is covered by task "Add Independence Relation". This task adds the corresponding "DECOMPOSITION" reference. Relation Type Related Element Mult.
